name: linkding "Add option to mark bookmarks as shared by default" (PR #1170)
intent: A visitor who has enabled sharing and set 'default_mark_shared' in their profile opens the 'Add bookmark' form, fills in a URL, and clicks Save WITHOUT touching the 'shared' checkbox — the walk must leave that checkbox untouched, exactly as the form loaded it. The persisted bookmark's shared column must equal 1 (the checkbox's own default state, driven by the profile setting — never explicitly toggled by the walk itself).
notes:
Cold-customer trial recipe (non-n8n, non-documenso). sissbruecker/linkding: self-hosted Django bookmark manager, single container, sqlite by default. PR #1170 adds UserProfile.default_mark_shared (migration 0048) and threads it into BookmarkForm.__init__'s GET-initial for the 'shared' checkbox on the new-bookmark form (bookmarks/forms.py). Discriminating walk: log in as the bootstrap superuser -> enable_sharing + default_mark_shared=True via /settings/update -> open /bookmarks/new -> type a URL, click Save WITHOUT touching the 'shared' checkbox -> persisted bookmarks_bookmark.shared must be 1. On the parent SHA the column/field/initial-wiring do not exist at all (migration 0048 absent), so the same walk lands shared=0 regardless of profile config. merge_sha 6c874afff230ee16b1939b3d4e1fa370a4203f44's single parent_sha 723b843c1360f29bb5908a4a501af756e736f843 verified via GET https://api.github.com/repos/sissbruecker/linkding/commits/<merge_sha> (one parent -- linear history, no merge-commit two-parent ambiguity). version.txt at the merge SHA still reads 1.42.0 (version bump happens at release time, not per-PR); CHANGELOG.md confirms #1170 first ships in v1.43.0.

LIVE-VALIDATION FIXES (this pass, all landed in src/, generalize past linkding): (1) body/body_file placeholders now resolve from setup+confirm captures (conjure.mjs resolveBodyPlaceholders) — the CSRF token login.json/profile.json reference as {csrf_token} actually lands on the wire. (2) setup/confirm steps accept 2xx AND 3xx as success (Django's login POST answers success with a 302, not 200 — the old <300 check misreported that as an error). (3) Django's login() rotates the CSRF token on success, so profile.json needs a token captured AFTER login, not before — added a 'profile_page' GET step. (4) /settings has no trailing slash (linkding's urls.py registers 'settings', not 'settings/'). (5) catch.mjs's confirmAgrees() coerces a JSON API boolean against the sqlite INTEGER 0/1 the store tap reads (same column, two honest representations) — the confirm leg's 'read' step now hits linkding's own DRF API (GET /api/bookmarks/, JSONPath $.results.0.shared, accounting for LimitOffsetPagination) instead of a guessed HTML regex against markup that never actually rendered a data-shared attribute. (6) added a recipe-level `intent` (above) wired through cli.mjs's prove command — the cold-Sonnet proposer, given only the generic 'persists an execution' default intent (n8n-shaped), clicked the shared checkbox as part of 'filling in the form', inverting the very default this PR discriminates on.

front_door.serves: the authenticated 'Add bookmark' form (bookmarks/new.html) -- a single-page, server-rendered form with url/title/description/tags/unread/shared fields. No placeholder needed (slice A made front_door placeholders optional) — this is a static creation-form path, used verbatim.

queries.bookmarks: SELECT id, shared FROM bookmarks_bookmark ORDER BY id DESC;

drive.reason: the 'Add bookmark' front door is a plain server-rendered HTML form (url/title/shared checkbox + Save button) -- a real click/type/click walk, no canvas. Slice B lands the setup cookie jar into the browser (handle.cookies -> client.addCookie) before navigating, so the front door is now reachable in principle; whether login itself completes still depends on the disclosed CSRF gap (notes gap A).
